The fix for TRUNK-6643 is commit `949b8a177e825320b0d04108accf38fc48751ed3` ("Initial setup with MariaDB Driver does not work", PR #6150, by jwnasambu). Before it, the wizard's database-creation, user-creation, and grant steps only checked `isCurrentDatabase(DATABASE_MYSQL)`, so a `jdbc:mariadb` URL fell through to the generic branch. The commit adds `|| isCurrentDatabase(DATABASE_MARIADB)` to each of those MySQL checks. It also adds the same MariaDB check to the InnoDB session-variable hack in `DatabaseUpdater`, and makes `isCurrentDatabase` protected so the tests can call it. The commit's tests cover both the MariaDB and MySQL URL cases.

The implementing lines in the current `InitializationFilter.java` are the `isCurrentDatabase` definition (1188), the create-database branch (1437), the drop-user branch (1492), the create-user branch (1501), and the grant branch (1518). The `DatabaseUpdater` InnoDB check is at line 486. The new tests are at lines 839-849 of `InitializationFilterE2ETest.java`.

Other MariaDB commits in the history are not part of this fix: TRUNK-6650 (`d8af2880`) is a follow-up to a different ticket, and TRUNK-6780 (`6d787a1e`) adds a MariaDB option to the test container harness.
